text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer developed body paragraphs with examples like \"Aladdin park,\" \"Sea view,\" and \"Safari Park\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"This captures how well an essay expands ideas with specific supporting details rather than merely stating them."},{"evidence":"organized with \"First,\" \"Secondly,\" \"Lastly,\" and a clear conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"This captures how effectively an essay groups ideas and guides the reader through its points."},{"evidence":"phrases like \"steaming hot Chicken Korma,\" \"buttery naan,\" and \"Mango lassi\"","quality":"specific description","description":"This captures the use of vivid, concrete details that make examples more precise and informative."},{"evidence":"uses transitions such as \"As you can see\" and clear topic paragraphs for parks, food, and people","quality":"cohesion","description":"This captures how smoothly an essay links sentences and sections together."},{"evidence":"generally accurate sentence forms like \"Pakistan is known for some of it's best amusement parks\" and \"The people are very nice\"","quality":"control of sentence structure","description":"This captures greater command of basic English sentence construction despite some errors."}]}
